company_id.normalization_requirement: must normalize to company_id before authorization, data access, storage, projection, execution, events or synchronization

titan-module-package/v1.security: ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 + SHA-256 canonical envelope; declarative payload only

titan.runtime.v1.compatibility_mode: known legacy events may be mirrored passively; mirroring grants no authority

titan.deployment.investigation-participa.authority: participation and assignment grant no execution authority

titan.module-platform-manager-lifecycle/.trusted_sender_policy: lifecycle mutations require a trusted extension context; ordinary web/content-script senders are rejected
titan.module-platform-manager-lifecycle/.authority: module identity, install, activation, recovery, bundle membership, marketplace presence and signed-package validity grant no execution authority
titan.module-platform-manager-lifecycle/.rollback: company activation and bundle suspend/resume are auditable and reversible; inherited activation may be restored without deleting company config
titan.module-platform-manager-lifecycle/.config_audit: configuration audit records changed key names, not configuration values
